reason: In cleanup_test.go:239-241 the seeded rows do get explicit IDs that bypass annotation_id_seq, but nothing in that test inserts annotations through the sequence (the annotationTag struct at xorm_store.go:663 has no annotation id, so tag inserts never use that sequence), and each subtest's t.Cleanup deletes all annotations. Each InitTestDB also runs TruncateDBTables (sqlstore.go:712/741), which on Postgres runs `TRUNCATE ... RESTART IDENTITY` (postgres_dialect.go:161), so no later sequence-based insert can collide with the seeded IDs.
